entries.title: Crewmates can copy a file from your other computers
entries.body: A crewmate working on one of your computers can now copy a file from another of them into its task's own folder, such as a picture you named by where it sits on your laptop. It reaches anything that computer's user can read, except Infinitary's own sign-ins and keys, and a database another app has open arrives complete. Each copy adds one line to the task's Activity, and the copy goes when the task closes. Both computers need this update.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears on screen beyond one ordinary line in the task's Activity for each copy; the change is what a crewmate can reach.
